name: mobile-navigation-fit
goal: All category links and labels fit visibly at mobile widths, alongside accessible search and revision controls

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: scope.md attributes clipping to compact-header commits and defines complete category/label visibility while preserving header controls

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing ui-search-fit fits guard now checks every category label across the viewport matrix, including 320px and selected Models; prior parent-only visibility missed clipped descendants

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable c0f830d0 fails the shared nav-label bounds guard at 320/390; original source is unchanged and real screenshots precede the assertion

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Opus will fit all seven icon-and-text category links in a compact wrapping mobile nav, retain controls, and preserve the existing header height bound; the shared bounds guard runs across the normal viewport matrix

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: 9bc8fb94 integrates the actual Opus grid, resets inherited tab minimum widths and retains non-mobile centering; the existing shared-search scenario now registers the full responsive guard

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Immutable 9bc8fb94 passes the same unchanged c0f830d0 tests, fixture corpus, command and runtime at 320/390. Green was recorded before test registration metadata changed.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
